name: sichao-li-academic-portfolio
description: Sichao Li's 3D academic portfolio with a reusable starter profile.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:template
scripts.format: prettier site profiles demo-3d demo package.json README.md .github/workflows/deploy.yml --write
scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run check:site
scripts.check:format: prettier site profiles demo-3d demo package.json README.md .github/workflows/deploy.yml --check
scripts.check:site: node demo-3d/build/checkSite.js sichao && node demo-3d/build/checkSite.js template
